notes: The first waw of the oracle body is `unrepresented`: the ASV opens *I will gather you* with no connective (rule 14's closing sentence).
בָּהֶם after אֲשֶׁר is resumptive and takes nothing, the relative alone being rendered *where* (rules 22, 40).
The two מִן are read off the ASV separately — *from* for the first, *out of* headed on *out* for the second (rule 24).
